mapper.select:
select finprod_id as finprodId, finprod_abbr as finprodAbbr from FIN_PRODUCT WHERE 1 = 1 and FINPROD_TYPE in ('F02','F03','F04','F05')
AND ( finprod_id like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') OR finprod_abbr like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') )
GROUP BY finprod_id, finprod_abbr

select A.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, A.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodType, A.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodTypeCode, A.PRIN as prin, A.CCY as ccy, DATE_FORMAT(A.VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as vdate1, DATE_FORMAT(A.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as mdate1, A.TERM as term, A.TERM_TYPE as termType, A.INT_TYPE as intType, A.INT_RATE*100 as intRate, A.INT_RATE_ID as intRateId, A.BASIS as basis, A.BASIS as basisCode, A.M_PRIN_AMT as mPrinAmt, A.M_INT_AMT as mIntAmt, A.M_TRADE_AMT as mTradeAmt, A.TRADE_MARKET AS tradeMarket, A.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE as capiIncomeFeature, A.CALENDAR_ID as calendarId FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT A WHERE (A.BRANCH = 0 OR A.BRANCH is null)
AND A.FINPROD_TYPE IN
#{finprodType}
AND A.FINPROD_ID like concat_ws('','%',#{repAsset},'%')
AND A.VDATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateBegin},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.VDATE <=STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.MDATE >=STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateBegin},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.MDATE <=STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')
